arrange_largest_number.instruction: b'Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.'

build_tower.instruction: b'Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.'

classify_objects.instruction: b'Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.'

cover_blocks.instruction: b'Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.'

deposit_coin.instruction: b'Pick up the coin from the holder and insert it precisely into the coin bank.'

dlc.instruction: b'Arrange the letters to spell "RoboDojo" in a row.'

fasten_screws.instruction: b'Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.'

fill_egg_holder.instruction: b'Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.'

fill_pen_holder.instruction: b'Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.'

hang_mugs.instruction: b'Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.'

imitate_sorting_sequence.instruction: b'Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.'

insert_key.instruction: b'Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.'

insert_tubes.instruction: b'Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.'

make_kong.instruction: b'Wait for the opponent to discard a tile, then declare a kong with the matching tiles.'

make_toast.instruction: b'Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.'

match_and_pick_from_conveyor.instruction: b'Remember the first object on the conveyor, then pick the matching object when it appears again.'

organize_table.instruction: b'Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on the stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.'

pack_objects_into_box.instruction: b'Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.'

play_Xylophone.instruction: b'Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.'

play_stacking_toy.instruction: b'Place all stacking toy pieces onto the correct pegs.'

play_tic_tac_toe.instruction: b'Play tic-tac-toe as the first player and fill the board with the opponent.'

plug_in_charger.instruction: b'Plug the charger into the power strip.'

pour_balls_into_vase.instruction: b'Pour all the balls from the cup into the vase.'

pour_liquid_into_cup.instruction: b'Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.'

press_by_number.instruction: b'Press the two red buttons the required number of times according to the number cards, then press the blue button to confirm.'

push_T.instruction: b'Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.'

put_bottles_into_dustbin.instruction: b'Pick up the bottles and throw them into the dustbin, using handover when needed.'

sort_nesting_dolls_by_size.instruction: b'Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.'

stack_blocks.instruction: b'Stack the three blocks with different textures.'

store_laptop_and_headphones.instruction: b'Hang the headphones on the headphone stand, close the laptop, then place it into the vertical laptop stand.'

swap_T.instruction: b'Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.'

swap_blocks.instruction: b'Swap the two blocks using the empty mat, pressing the button after each move.'

sweep_blocks.instruction: b'Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.'
